HOW IT WORKS

From curiosity
to a clear next step.

A straightforward way to explore herbs, prepare your order enquiry and speak with a real person.

01

Choose your herbs. Add your details.

Browse the collections, review the herb details and add your choices to the bag. At checkout, enter your contact and delivery details, then review everything together. Each collection introduces a category; discuss the exact herb with Dr Stevens.

Explore the shop
02

Discuss it with Dr Stevens.

Send your full cart and delivery details on WhatsApp. Discuss product ingredients, suitability, prices and delivery, and agree the order before payment. Consultation is free, and we aim to reply within an hour.

Ask us a question
03

Receive with guidance.

Once the order and delivery arrangements are agreed, receive your herbs and speak with Dr Stevens about the best way to use them for your circumstances.

Ask Dr Stevens

YOU CAN START ANYWHERE

Not ready to choose?

Consultation is free. Start with your questions instead of a product. We aim to reply within an hour.

Start a consultation

What happens after you send?

A reply from the team

We aim to reply within an hour. The team will discuss your questions and agree the next steps with you.

A suitability conversation

Discuss product ingredients, directions and precautions with Dr Stevens. Do not share sensitive medical records in an initial message.

Clear details before payment

Confirm the actual product, final total, payment method, delivery estimate and return terms before paying.
